name: ShareReady Stage 01 evidence-first product definition
milestones: A1 independent task evidence and missingness transparently recorded
At least two competitor paths tested on synthetic fixtures with export evidence
Consent-based participant results or explicit INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
Reviewable PRD + conditional Rust architecture and GO/PIVOT/NO-GO decision

steps.title: S01 Verify A1 user-problem signals and recruitment feasibility
steps.done_when: An evidence inventory contains at least two dated, independently attributable real-user problem statements, flags developer promotion, and records whether actual recruiting is feasible; no interview claims invented
steps.verify: Reviewer checks dated links, actual statement context, sampling limits, and explicit recruitment status

steps.title: S02 Four competitor evidence records and five synthetic fixtures
steps.done_when: At least four competitors have source/version/environment rows and five generated synthetic images have machine-readable sensitive/retained region ground truth; no real personal information
steps.verify: Check source provenance and manually review each PNG/JPEG + machine-readable fixture manifest; static claims are not measured tests

steps.title: S03 Two actual competitor flows on synthetic T01/T02
steps.done_when: Two available tools each complete comparable end-to-end T01/T02 trials or have explicit blocked-by-platform records, including timings, omission counts, exported artifact paths and exact versions
steps.verify: Observe real interaction, independent exports and ground truth; report inability to run separately; webpage claims do not count

steps.title: S04 Ethics and consent based recruitment prep
steps.done_when: A reviewed neutral recruitment screener, consent protocol, private identity handling and randomized AB/BA task orders exist with honest recruitment count
steps.verify: Review protocol against participant pack; preserve versioned recruitment status and refusal counts

steps.title: S05a Real participant sessions batch one
steps.done_when: First batch of up to five actually consenting participants has anonymized event-based interviews and task outputs, or BLOCKED_BY_RECRUITMENT is documented; no synthetic people
steps.verify: Independently check consent ledger privately, anonymous summary, actual sample size, per-task rows and export truth, including failures

steps.title: S05b Real participant sessions batch two
steps.done_when: Second batch of up to five actually consenting participants has preserved anonymous outputs, or transparent shortfall with reasons; no claimed quota if unmet
steps.verify: Independently verify actual count and missingness, per-task results and anonymization, including early stop decisions

steps.title: S06 Evidence-linked PRD review
steps.done_when: Every P0/P1/non-goal and user story is marked approved, rework, defer or not-verified with source; A1/A2 decision and stop decision explicitly recorded
steps.verify: Trace each requirement to recorded research or clearly mark unverified; verify stage 01 PRD review document exists

steps.title: S07 Conditional Rust architecture review
steps.done_when: Leptos CSR/WASM, Tauri 2, egui/Slint compared on observed user workflow, security limits, deployment, platform UX; no code SPIKE implied
steps.verify: Review constraints against real research, source documentation and ADR, mark measurements still missing

steps.title: S08 Evidence-to-decision review by separate reviewer
steps.done_when: Review contains evidence table covering criteria 1–5, actual measurement count, independent reviewer identity/independence and GO/PIVOT/NO-GO/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE outcome
steps.verify: An independent reviewer inspects actual artifacts, verifies CLI coverage and flags any absent real user/security evidence

if_then.if: Real users already meet sharing needs with current free screenshot tools
if_then.then: Record A1 counterevidence, remove unique-value claims and consider PIVOT/NO-GO before further work

if_then.if: Recruitment is below planned sample or consent not established
if_then.then: Record true N and BLOCKED_BY_RECRUITMENT or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; never substitute synthetic sessions

if_then.if: Browser clipboard or WASM fails on a target environment
if_then.then: Retain user problem definition and request new architecture SPIKE approval rather than silently changing the framework
Use ShareReady only internally until branding review

early_signals: Recent screenshot sharing does not imply redaction frequency; count privacy-relevant events separately
Competitor baselines match or exceed the hypothesized workflow without switching cost
User participants cannot be recruited without exposing real private screenshots
A UI-only success claim conflicts with pixel/metadata export evidence
